name: Camellya

tierList.prydwen: T2 Tower of Adversity, T3 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Havoc Sword Main DPS with the longest rotation of any Main DPS in the game. Forte gauge 'Crimson Pistils' (max 100, restored only by Intro and Forte Skill) fuels a dual-form kit: White Hair (mobile, single-target, better tracking) vs Red Hair 'Blossom Mode' (AoE spin, immobile, faster Pistil consumption).

skills.normalAttack: Burgeoning - up to 5-hit chain; in Blossom Mode replaced by faster 'Vining Waltz'/'Blazing Waltz' spin attacks.
skills.resonanceSkill: Valse of Bloom and Blight - Crimson Blossom enters Blossom Mode; Floral Ravage exits it.
skills.forte: Vegetative Universe - consumes Crimson Pistils for buffed Energy Regen, builds Crimson Buds; at full Concerto, Ephemeral (Basic-type nuke) triggers Budding Mode (+50% dmg multiplier on Basic/Skill-type attacks, +5% per Crimson Bud consumed, up to +50%).
skills.liberation: Fervor Efflorescent - Havoc DMG nuke, mid-air castable.
skills.intro: Everblooming - Havoc DMG, restores 100 Crimson Pistils.
skills.outro: Twining - Havoc DMG (329% ATK, or 459% ATK if following an Ephemeral cast).

echoSet: Havoc Eclipse (5pc, best, ramping Havoc DMG)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Sanhua is the F2P-friendly hybrid choice; Lynae is currently the strongest generalist buffer for her.

rotation: Standard (Red Hair, best DPS): Intro -> Skill (Crimson Blossom) -> Echo/Dash cancels -> Vining/Blazing Waltz spins -> Ultimate -> Skill (Ephemeral, Budding Mode) -> more Vining/Blazing Waltz -> Skill (Floral Ravage) -> Outro. White Hair variant available for better single-target tracking at the cost of DPS. Whole rotation exceeds 15s, longer than most Outro buff durations.
communityNotes: Prydwen: F2P-friendly and flexible (AoE Red Hair vs tracking-friendly White Hair) but held back by having the longest DPS rotation in the game, meaning Outro buffs frequently expire before her backloaded Budding Mode damage lands; hasn't received a strong teammate refresh in a long time and is considered behind the current damage ceiling as of 3.2, though still capable of clearing content on a budget.
